{

  "mode": "scripted",
  "task": {
    "id": "swap_deposit",
    "title": "兑换后存入",
    "input": "使用实验amm将10 TokenA兑换为TokenB（至少9 TokenB），随后只将本次兑换新增的TokenB全部存入实验vault，份额归agent；保留运行前已有的TokenB和份额。用兑换后的B余额减去本次initialState中的B余额确定新增数量，或核对成功兑换的amountOut。先按需授权：已有allowance足够则跳过，否则设置为本次所需数量。工具amount/amountIn/minAmountOut使用十进制代币单位字符串；链状态余额和allowance为精度6的整数最小单位字符串，1 token=1000000最小单位。",
    "allowedTools": [
      "get_balance",
      "get_state",
      "approve_token",
      "swap",
      "deposit"
    ],
    "completion": "本次正确兑换、新增B全部进入vault、agent份额按本次存入增加；原有B余额、份额和其他账户资产保留。",
    "taskParameters": {
      "amountIn": "10",
      "minAmountOut": "9"
    },
    "parameterSource": "structured",
    "tokenDecimals": 6
  },
  "automine": true,
  "manual": false,
  "template": "legacy_task",
  "experimentMode": "independent",
  "maxSteps": 30,
  "maxMessages": 0,
  "agents": [
    {

      "goal": {},
      "model": {

        "temperature": 0
      },
      "maxModelCalls": 20,
      "maxTokens": 100000,
      "maxGasWei": "100000000000000000",
      "tools": [
        "get_balance",
        "transfer_token",
        "approve_token",
        "swap",
        "deposit"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
